title: Mar-a-Lago Jet Tragedy, Ryanair Freezes Pay, and Southwest's Expiring Denials
summary: A Learjet goes down near Mar-a-Lago with nine on board, and we talk about what that nose-dive means for the investigation ahead. Then: Ryanair blames the Middle East conflict for a two billion dollar fuel hit and starts freezing paychecks, Boeing gets a surprising green light to sell jets to Belarus despite Russia fears, and Southwest's CEO denies a widebody order using the exact same playbook he used right before killing free bags.
